Header: Yellow rice borer ( Scirpophaga incertulas ), White rice borer ( Scirpophaga innotata ), Striped borer ( Chilo suppressalis ), Pink Borer ( Sesamia inferens )

Prevention: Always harvest the preceding rice crop from soil line to prevent carryover of the pest in the succeeding crop (sanitation).
Ploughing and water inundation (for 7 days) just after harvest of the previous season rice.
Use of early maturing and dwarf varieties (Mid hill:
Ghaiya 2 (unirrigated), Radha 4, Tarahara 1, DY 18, DY 28, DY 69, Tara, Suraj).
NPK kg/ha for irrigated and 6 ton
Plant soybean on bunds to repel the pests and conserve natural enemies.
Protect spiders and long-horned grasshoppers in and around the field.
Monitoring: Regularly monitor at 7-day intervals from tillering to heading stage for the following: check for egg masses on 40 random hills along the diagonal of the field.
Check also for 'dead hearts' and white earheads.
Monitor moths weekly in light traps.
Action threshold: 2 egg masses per 20 hills up to panicle initiation stage, and 1 egg mass thereafter.
You may also consider action when >10% deadhearts are observed.
Direct Control: Clipping of the tip of seedlings before transplanting.
Trichogramma egg parasitoids @ 50000-100000 /ha weekly up to 6 times, if available.
Bt @ 3 g/litre of water after 3 week of transplanting.
Restrictions: Don't drain out water for at least 4 days after application of chemicals.
